purpose: Define how the cube handles cultural, religious, Indigenous, family, and community-governed death knowledge.
hard_rules: A public source may establish that a term exists; it does not authorize the archive to teach the practice.
A family or community may decline explanation; refusal is a valid boundary and must not be treated as missing data to overcome.
Restricted, initiatory, sacred, ceremonial, Indigenous, child, or trauma-linked material cannot enter public surfaces without explicit sovereign/community permission and review.
The archive preserves specificity: denomination, lineage, region, family, diaspora context, local law, institution, and individual wishes are not interchangeable.
No generated synthesis may speak in the first-person voice of a community unless supplied and approved by that community.
withdrawal_rule: If a tradition holder, family, contributor, or community requests withdrawal or correction, dependent surfaces enter rollback review before any further release.
